articles.headline: USMNT's Folarin Balogun has red card suspended by FIFA, available to face Belgium
articles.description: FIFA have suspended the red card USMNT striker Folarin Balogun received in the match against Bosnia-Herzegovina, meaning he is available to face Belgium in the round-of-16.
